definitionZh: 帧大小的 CSS 属性可以用来设定一个iframe元素的横向或纵向大小,以等同其嵌入式文档在同一维度的布局大小,但只有当嵌入式文档选择了共享其大小信息时.
sourceDefinition: The frame-sizing CSS property can be used to set an iframe element's horizontal or vertical size to equal the layout size of its embedded document in the same dimension, but only if the embedded document has opted in to sharing its size information.
